archetypes.name: dyn-ratchet-relocation
archetypes.rationale: Relocation-key matching must preserve reasons without masking new debt.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the two ratchet linters' --write relocation logic. Check that exact matches win, unique basename-plus-identity relocations preserve the old reason, and duplicate old or live relocation keys fail before --initial-reason can apply. Pay special attention to absent-baseline bootstrap behavior and env keys staying distinct by qualified_symbol and occurrence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
